c6bbbeca-f4fd-4595-9d4d-4ba31370d08c.altTitle: I Reincarnated into an Otome Game as a Villainess With Only Destruction Flags...
c6bbbeca-f4fd-4595-9d4d-4ba31370d08c.description: I recovered my past memories when I was hit on the head by a rock. I am Katarina Claes, the eight year old daughter of the duke. In a feverish nightmare, in which the prince’s fiancee was determined, I have realized that this is the otome game from the previous life. Also, I have turned into the villainess that interfered with the romance of the capture targets… If the heroine got a happy end, I would be exiled, while if she got a bad end, I would be killed by the capture target… I have no happy end!? Why is it only bad!? Somehow I have to avoid the destruction end, and reach old age peacefully!!

d413c71b-8eb5-44c5-8590-7c38908de419.title: Trapped at Home With the Male Leads
d413c71b-8eb5-44c5-8590-7c38908de419.altTitle: The Male Leads Trapped in My House
d413c71b-8eb5-44c5-8590-7c38908de419.description: Aku bereinkarnasi sebagai pewaris sebuah konglomerat dalam novel tersebut. Namun, ada masalah, dunia ini akan dihancurkan oleh monster virus. Yang tersisa hanya uang, aku harus segera membeli tanah di pedesaan dan membangun tempat perlindungan untuk menghindari monster... Dunia runtuh jauh lebih cepat dari yang kukira, sial!" Dan entah bagaimana, bahkan para tokoh utama pria terperangkap bersamaku di rumahku. Tapi sepertinya kedua orang ini tidak mau pergi. Kenapa rasanya seolah-olah kalian tidak berniat untuk pergi ke tokoh utama wanita? "Apa-apaan kamu ini?" "Kurasa rasa dia tahu tentang kenyataan bahwa dunia akan hancur." Mereka punya banyak pertanyaan untukku, tapi aku tidak bisa menjawabnya. Lagipula, kalian juga tidak akan percayaku, kan? Sekarang, di mataku, mereka hanya terlihat seperti sumber daya tenaga yang berguna. "Sekarang ayo kita mulai bekerja, bayar sebanyak yang kamu makan!" Kalau kita berhasil menemukan obat untuk virus, penyebab kehancuran dunia, masa-masa neraka kita akan berakhir. Jadi, ayo manfaatkan para tokoh utama pria sampai saat itu dan bertahanlah! Tapi ada satu masalah. Rumah tua yangki beli ternyata cukup mencurigakan. Apa yang sebenarnya terjadi di rumahku?

fd5920bb-15cc-4525-b545-867d404b5e36.title: The Cellhouse Kingmaker's Playbook
fd5920bb-15cc-4525-b545-867d404b5e36.altTitle: I Became a Leader in a Wretched Prison
fd5920bb-15cc-4525-b545-867d404b5e36.description:
I Woke Up as the Leader of Prison?!
I got transmigrated into a book, but—excuse me, what?!
What am I supposed to do when I transmigrate ten years before the original story even starts?

The setting: prison.
The problem: it's worse than the jungle. A lawless war zone.

After rolling through hell for ten years, I became…

The leader of the prison.

"Hey, Mint. You might wanna chill."
"I’m afraid I don’t know what you’re talking about, sir."

I ended up a swaggering prison gang leader.
But hey, I’m fine with this.
This is what we call the privilege of a long-time survivor.

"On paper, you’ll be considered dead. In return, you’ll do a job for me."
"I’m afraid I still don’t understand, sir."

Then a chance came—like a lie made real.

"Help me, and I’ll get you released."
"What do you need, Master?"
"..."

The prison chief gave an order to me—now known as the prison’s #1 certified nutcase:

"Turn the new guy into the boss of this prison."

They call it prison, but this place is a total free-for-all.
And if I manage to crown one man as the next boss, I finally get out.

"But the place you're going to… is the men’s prison."
"...Huh? I don’t exactly have the thing for that?"
"Disguise. Got it? Disguise!"

…Except—oops?
Turns out that new recruit? He’s the original male lead.

#ButTheNewGuyIsTheML?!
